title: Recover a functional graph
statementMd:
Functional graph is a directed graph in which all vertices have outdegree equal to $1$. Loops are allowed.

Some vertices of a functional graph lay on a cycle. From the others we can come to a cycle by making a finite number of steps along the edges (we consider only finite functional graphs in this problem).

Let's compute two values for each vertex. $*precycle*_{*i*}$ is the amount of edges we should pass to get to a vertex which is a part of some cycle (zero, if $*i*$ itself lies on a cycle), $*cycle*_{*i*}$ is the length of the cycle we get to.

You are given the information about these values for some functional graph. For each vertex you know the values $*precycle*_{*i*}$ and $*cycle*_{*i*}$, however, instead of some values there can be the question mark. It means that these values are unknown.

Build any functional graph that suits the description or determine that there is no such graph.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 300$) — the number of vertices in the graph.

Each of the next $*n*$ lines contain two integers — $*precycle*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *precycle*_{*i*} ≤ *n* - 1$) and $*cycle*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *cycle*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$). There could be question marks instead of some of these values.

## Output

In case there is no solution, print `-1`.

Otherwise, print $*n*$ integers. $*i*$-th of them is the number of vertex to which the edge form the $*i*$-th vertex go.

The vertices should be in the same order as they go in input data.

If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
函数图是一种有向图，其中所有顶点的出度都等于 $1$。允许存在自环。

函数图中的一些顶点位于某个环上。从其他顶点出发，沿边经过有限步即可到达某个环（本题中只考虑有限函数图）。

我们为每个顶点计算两个值。$*precycle*_{*i*}$ 表示到达某个环上的顶点所需经过的边数（如果顶点 $*i*$ 本身位于某个环上，则该值为零），$*cycle*_{*i*}$ 表示最终到达的环的长度。

给定某个函数图中这些值的信息。对于每个顶点，你都知道 $*precycle*_{*i*}$ 和 $*cycle*_{*i*}$ 的值，但其中一些值可能被问号代替，表示这些值未知。

请构造任意一个符合描述的函数图，或者判断不存在这样的函数图。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 300$）——图中顶点的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数——$*precycle*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *precycle*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$ - 1）和 $*cycle*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *cycle*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）。其中一些值可能被问号代替。

## 输出格式

如果不存在解，输出 `-1`。

否则，输出 $*n*$ 个整数。其中第 $*i*$ 个整数表示从第 $*i*$ 个顶点出发的边所指向的顶点编号。

顶点的顺序应与输入数据中的顺序相同。

如果有多个解，输出其中任意一个即可。
